## GFIN Growth Live Monitor

Read-only dashboard. It queries n8n execution history and workflow definitions; it never executes or edits GFIN workflows.

**One-time credentials:**
1. `GFIN Monitor n8n API` — Base URL: `https://awf.deeplearningintelligence.com`; use the **n8n API key**, not the MCP access token.
2. `GFIN Monitor Dashboard Login` — choose a username/password for the dashboard.

After credentials are filled, publish this workflow and open `/webhook/gfin-growth-monitor`.

The dashboard auto-refreshes every 60 seconds and flags hidden node-level errors, missing scheduled runs, unitless Wait nodes, and fragile `defineBelow` Sheets writes.
